name: MT103 to pacs.008 Document Mapping for CBPR+
description: Maps MT103 message to ISO 20022 pacs.008.001.08 FIToFICustomerCreditTransferV08 document structure according to CBPR+ translation specification

tasks.name: Initialize Temp Data
tasks.description: Initializes temp data with sender and receiver BIC codes for TR001 compatibility

tasks.name: Initialize Clearing System Codes
tasks.description: Define clearing system code mappings for IsMTClearingSystemCodeInList validation (TR002, TR003)

tasks.name: Determine Settlement Method and Agents
tasks.description: Implements CBPR+ 4-table decision logic for fields 53a/54a/55a to determine settlement method (INDA/INGA/COVE), reimbursement agents, settlement accounts, and instruction routing based on BIC relationships

tasks.name: Construct Group Header
tasks.description: Builds pacs.008 group header with message identification, creation timestamp, settlement information, and reimbursement agent details from MT103 fields and computed settlement method

tasks.name: Map Instructing and Instructed Agents
tasks.description: Maps InstgAgt and InstdAgt to CdtTrfTxInf from temp_data values

tasks.name: Preprocess Field 23E - Instruction Codes
tasks.description: Process field 23E instruction codes including CHQB, HOLD, PHOB, TELB for InstructionForCdtrAgt

if: PHOB: Please advise beneficiary by phone.
TELB: Please advise beneficiary by other telecommunication.

tasks.name: Preprocess Field 72 - Extract Codes
tasks.description: Implements TR011 code extraction from field 72, excluding /INS/, /ACC/, /REC/, /BNF/ codes

tasks.name: Map Credit Transfer Transaction Info
tasks.description: Maps credit transfer transaction information in sub-paths including payment identification, settlement amounts, dates, charge bearer, parties, agents, and remittance information from MT103 fields to pacs.008 CdtTrfTxInf structure

tasks.name: Map Charges and Regulatory Information
tasks.description: Maps consolidated charges information (71F/71G sender/receiver charges) and regulatory reporting details from field 77B including debtor/creditor country of residence for compliance purposes

tasks.name: Parse Regulatory Codes from Field 77B
tasks.description: Extracts /BENEFRES/ and /ORDERRES/ codes from field 77B and maps them to creditor and debtor country of residence

tasks.name: Generate Document XML
tasks.description: Generates the pacs.008 document XML output for normal MT103 processing using the PublishMX function

tasks.name: Generate STP Document XML
tasks.description: Generates the pacs.008 document XML output for STP MT103 processing using the PublishMX function
